behaviorContracts.name: guest-string-code-generation
behaviorContracts.note: Hooks and Client reject string eval/Function through direct, bound, Reflect.construct and ordinary/async/generator/async-generator constructor paths before plugin registration. behaviorContracts.note: Synchronous registration with frozen JSON options, exact registration closure and 128-entry limit; duplicate unqualified registrations, asynchronous register and repeated/invalid catch are rejected. behaviorContracts.name: matcher/glob/depth/regex-budget
behaviorContracts.note: Exact, star, namespace-star and negated event matching; recursive value/object/array and RegExp matchers execute in the bounded guest with depth limit 8 and VM deadline. No general filesystem glob syntax or unbounded regular-expression execution is claimed.

behaviorContracts.name: registration.catch/failure-policy
behaviorContracts.note: Optional-hook recovery keeps the latest settled next result or skips a failed hook before next; one catch may recover, but downstream errors/cancellation propagate and completed side effects are not replayed or rolled back. engine.create recovery remains unavailable. Mandatory host checks stay outside optional fallback.

behaviorContracts.name: next.origin/next.trace
behaviorContracts.note: Origin and bounded host trace snapshots are exposed through the real continuation, including outcomes and host timing. Trace fields are CMB diagnostic projections, not full upstream internal traces or authority tokens.

behaviorContracts.name: tiers/next.to
behaviorContracts.note: Dispatcher snapshots prepend/user/append/builtin/core order and next.to applies a downstream tier floor. No jump can restore skipped owner authorization or transfer host capabilities; full upstream installation-tier policy is not claimed.

behaviorContracts.name: field-mutability-and-result-schemas
behaviorContracts.note: Implemented production events normalize/pin their protected identity fields and validate JSON/result envelopes before host execution/publication. Validation is event-specific and bounded; known catalog names do not establish a schema or trigger for all upstream events.

behaviorContracts.name: multi-next/model-attempt-accounting
behaviorContracts.note: Distinct next calls execute separate downstream requests under the original host request identity and model/turn accounting; per-dispatch next/core request limits and cancellation remain. Tests do not establish identical accounting for every external provider or billing system.

behaviorContracts.name: stream-yield-vs-generator-return
behaviorContracts.note: Streaming continuations separate yielded chunks from the terminal result; yield-star forwards the latter, repeated next opens fresh requests, bounded queues apply, and provider failure does not replay it. Already emitted chunks are not rolled back when an optional transform fails. Only implemented production stream shapes are covered.

behaviorContracts.name: engine.create/provider-contract
behaviorContracts.note: Provider state stays in its guest; delegated calls preserve authority, lease, cancellation and capability intersection. JSON methods only; stream providers, generated schemas and failed-provider recovery remain unsupported.

behaviorContracts.name: claude-package-import
behaviorContracts.note: Actual Claude plugin metadata/hooks/module layout and the CMB v2 manifest are compiled from immutable snapshots; statically captured Client sources and host revision enter the approved digest. Only bounded relative static imports are allowed; arbitrary bare/dynamic modules and full upstream plugin installation behavior are not supported. Plugin checking does not grant authority or certify business acceptance.

behaviorContracts.name: testing-api/mocks/tier/engine
behaviorContracts.note: The reference fixtures have been exercised with upstream plugin test and CMB real guest/session runners, but this application does not expose the complete upstream testing API, arbitrary mock engine or tier runner to installed plugins. Internal test helpers are not a production compatibility adapter.

behaviorContracts.name: v1-adapter-and-data-migration
